scripts.docker:up: pnpm --filter '@careeros/shared' --filter '@careeros/secrets' --filter '@careeros/auth' --filter '@careeros/ai' build && docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker/docker-compose.override.yml up -d
scripts.docker:rebuild: pnpm --filter '@careeros/shared' --filter '@careeros/secrets' --filter '@careeros/auth' --filter '@careeros/ai' build && docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker/docker-compose.override.yml up -d --build
scripts.docker:infra: docker compose --env-file .env $([ -f .env.local ] && echo --env-file .env.local) -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker/docker-compose.host-dev.yml up -d postgres redis qdrant minio squid
scripts.docker:infra:down: docker compose --env-file .env $([ -f .env.local ] && echo --env-file .env.local) -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker/docker-compose.host-dev.yml down
